_comment: Ordering pipelines. `leiden_llp` is the published pipeline (unseeded partitioner, per-cluster LLP, clusters concatenated size-descending, no small-cluster merge). Algorithm 1 in the paper described an extra LLP-seeding stage that was never implemented and, when implemented, measures WORSE on 4/4 datasets (see research/graph_compression/seed_ablation/VERDICT.md) -- it is therefore not offered here.

leiden_llp_merged._note: cnr-2000 was published with no merge; a sweep on 2026-09-06 found tau=75 optimal there (BG 2.3216 -> 2.1771). The published null value is the worst tested. Re-select tau per dataset before regenerating tables.
